title: [Sample] Psilocybin-Assisted Therapy for Treatment-Resistant Depression
briefSummary: SAMPLE DATA - invented for a demo. This study tests whether two guided sessions with psilocybin, plus talk therapy before and after, can reduce depression in adults whose depression has not improved after trying at least two antidepressants. Participants are randomly assigned to psilocybin or an active comparison pill. The study lasts about 12 weeks and includes 8 in-person visits. Participants receive up to $600 for completed visits.
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Adults aged 21 to 65
* Diagnosis of major depressive disorder, current episode lasting at least 8 weeks
* Did not improve after at least 2 antidepressant medicines taken at an adequate dose and duration in the current episode
* Willing to stop current antidepressant medicines under medical supervision before dosing

Exclusion Criteria:
* Pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy during the study
* Personal or close family history of schizophrenia or bipolar I disorder
* Uncontrolled high blood pressure or significant heart disease
* Insulin-dependent diabetes
* Current substance use disorder

title: [Sample] Accelerated Brain Stimulation (TMS) for Depression That Has Not Responded to Medication
briefSummary: SAMPLE DATA - invented for a demo. This study tests an accelerated form of transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS), which uses magnetic pulses on the scalp to stimulate parts of the brain linked to mood. Participants receive 10 short sessions a day for 5 days in a row, then 4 follow-up visits over 3 months. TMS sessions are provided at no cost. Travel costs of up to $40 per visit day are reimbursed.
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Adults aged 18 to 70
* Major depressive disorder, current episode
* Did not improve after at least 2 antidepressant medicines
* Able to attend daily visits for 5 consecutive weekdays

Exclusion Criteria:
* History of seizures or epilepsy
* Metal implants in the head, cochlear implants, or a pacemaker
* Pregnancy
* Active psychosis
* Changes to antidepressant medicine in the last 4 weeks

locations.facility: Columbia University Irving Medical Center (sample site)

title: [Sample] Esketamine Nasal Spray vs. Added Medication for Depression in Adults 60 and Older
briefSummary: SAMPLE DATA - invented for a demo. This study compares two options for older adults whose depression has not improved enough on antidepressants: esketamine nasal spray given in a clinic, or adding a second pill (aripiprazole). The study lasts 16 weeks. Some follow-up visits can be done by video call. The listing does not mention payment.
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Adults aged 60 to 85
* Major depressive disorder
* Did not improve after at least 2 antidepressant medicines
* Medical conditions such as diabetes or high blood pressure are allowed if stable

Exclusion Criteria:
* Dementia or significant memory problems
* Uncontrolled high blood pressure
* History of psychosis
* Current alcohol or drug use disorder

title: [Sample] Spanish-Language Digital CBT App for Depression
briefSummary: SAMPLE DATA - invented for a demo. This study tests a smartphone app that teaches cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) skills in Spanish, with weekly 15-minute phone check-ins from a bilingual coach. Everything is done from home. The program lasts 8 weeks, with a final check-in at 3 months. Participants receive up to $100 in gift cards for completing surveys.
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Adults aged 18 to 70
* Prefers to receive care in Spanish
* Symptoms of depression (score of 10 or higher on a short depression questionnaire)
* Has a smartphone

Exclusion Criteria:
* Currently in weekly talk therapy
* Bipolar disorder or psychosis
* Needs a higher level of care, as judged by the study clinician
interventions: Behavioral: Spanish-language CBT app with coaching

title: [Sample] Zuranolone for Depression After Childbirth
briefSummary: SAMPLE DATA - invented for a demo. This study tests zuranolone, a pill taken once a day for 14 days, for depression that starts during pregnancy or within 4 weeks after giving birth. Participants are followed for 6 weeks. The listing does not say how many visits there are or whether there is payment.
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Women aged 18 to 45
* Gave birth within the last 6 months
* Major depressive episode that began in the third trimester or within 4 weeks after delivery

Exclusion Criteria:
* Currently pregnant
* Breastfeeding during the 14-day treatment period (pumping and discarding is allowed)
* History of bipolar disorder or psychosis
* Kidney or liver disease

title: [Sample] Mindfulness Program for Anxiety During Pregnancy
briefSummary: SAMPLE DATA - invented for a demo. This study tests an 8-week mindfulness group program for pregnant people with anxiety. Groups meet once a week for 90 minutes by video, and there is a 10-minute daily practice at home. No medicine is involved. Participants receive $25 for each of 3 survey visits.
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Pregnant, between 12 and 28 weeks at the time of joining
* Aged 18 to 45
* Generalized anxiety disorder or significant anxiety symptoms
* Able to join video sessions in English

Exclusion Criteria:
* High-risk pregnancy requiring bed rest
* Current psychosis or bipolar disorder
* Already practicing meditation more than 2 times a week

title: [Sample] Team-Based Care for Depression and Type 2 Diabetes
briefSummary: SAMPLE DATA - invented for a demo. This study tests whether a care team (a nurse, a care manager, and a psychiatrist working together with your regular doctor) helps people manage both depression and type 2 diabetes. Participants have monthly visits or phone calls for 12 months. The listing does not mention payment.
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Adults aged 40 to 80
* Type 2 diabetes with an A1c between 7% and 11%
* Symptoms of depression
* Gets primary care at a participating clinic or is willing to transfer care

Exclusion Criteria:
* Type 1 diabetes
* Kidney failure needing dialysis
* Dementia
* Bipolar disorder or psychosis

locations.facility: SUNY Downstate Health Sciences University (sample site)

title: [Sample] Walking and Strength Program for Depression in Older Adults
briefSummary: SAMPLE DATA - invented for a demo. This study tests whether a supervised exercise program helps older adults with depression. Participants exercise 3 times a week for 12 weeks, either at the center or at home with a video coach. Participants receive $50 at the end of the program.
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Adults aged 60 and older
* Major depressive disorder
* Doctor's clearance to exercise

Exclusion Criteria:
* Unable to walk without help
* Heart attack or stroke in the last 6 months
* Already exercising more than 2 times a week

title: [Sample] TF-201 Added to Current Antidepressant for Major Depression
briefSummary: SAMPLE DATA - invented for a demo. TF-201 is an invented example drug. This study tests whether adding the TF-201 pill to a person's current antidepressant improves depression compared with a placebo (a pill with no medicine). The study lasts 10 weeks with 7 clinic visits. Participants are paid up to $350 and can get help with travel.
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Adults aged 18 to 65
* Major depressive disorder
* Currently taking an SSRI or SNRI antidepressant at a stable dose for at least 6 weeks, with not enough improvement
* Tried 1 to 3 antidepressants in the current episode

Exclusion Criteria:
* Pregnant or breastfeeding
* Diabetes treated with insulin
* History of seizures
* Suicide attempt in the past 12 months

title: [Sample] Ketamine Infusions for Hard-to-Treat Depression
briefSummary: SAMPLE DATA - invented for a demo. This study compares 6 low-dose ketamine infusions, given through a vein over 3 weeks, with an active comparison medicine. Each infusion visit takes about 3 hours, and someone must drive the participant home. The study lasts 8 weeks.
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Adults aged 21 to 60
* Major depressive disorder
* Did not improve after at least 2 antidepressant medicines

Exclusion Criteria:
* Pregnancy
* Uncontrolled high blood pressure
* History of ketamine or other drug misuse
* History of psychosis

title: [Sample] At-Home Bright Light Therapy for Depression
briefSummary: SAMPLE DATA - invented for a demo. This study tests whether sitting in front of a bright light box for 30 minutes each morning helps depression that is not seasonal. The light box is mailed to participants, and all visits happen by video. The study lasts 8 weeks. Participants keep the light box at the end.
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Adults aged 18 to 75
* Major depressive disorder
* Lives in New York State
* On a stable antidepressant dose for 4 weeks, or not taking one

Exclusion Criteria:
* Bipolar disorder
* Eye diseases such as macular degeneration or glaucoma
* Night-shift work
* Pregnancy

title: [Sample] Sertraline or Online CBT for Generalized Anxiety
briefSummary: SAMPLE DATA - invented for a demo. This study compares two common treatments for generalized anxiety: the medicine sertraline, or an online cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) program. Participants are randomly assigned to one. The study lasts 12 weeks with 5 visits, which can be in person or by video. The listing does not mention payment.
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Adults aged 18 to 65
* Generalized anxiety disorder as the main concern

Exclusion Criteria:
* Pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy
* Took sertraline in the past without benefit
* Currently taking medicine for anxiety or depression
* Bipolar disorder or psychosis
